Using hyperpowers:using-hyperpowers — this request hits rung 1 of the ladder (a field name is an interface others call), so I'm stopping before editing.

The change itself is one line, `routes/users.js:6` — `userId: u.id` → `user_id: u.id`. The consequence is not one line:

- `README.md` names three live consumers of `GET /users`: the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export. All three read `userId` today and would get `undefined` after the rename.
- The README also states the project's own rule: "Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint."
- The iOS consumer is the hard one — shipped clients can't be updated in lockstep with the server.

So the rename as asked is a breaking contract change that bypasses the documented versioning policy.
